events.what: Nashik-Trimbakeshwar Simhastha Kumbh Mela 2027: Amrit Snan bathing days on 2 August and 31 August 2027 at both centres, then 11 September at Nashik and 12 September at Trimbakeshwar. The core mela runs June to September 2027. The authority calls these plan dates interim.
events.effect: Mass gathering: very heavy crowds, road and rail congestion around Nashik
